models_evaluated: commercial AI algorithm for PE detection on CTPA (unnamed)

links.outcome: Local AI sensitivity and specificity for PE on CTPA against radiologist reference standard
links.effect: First evaluation sensitivity 84.6%, specificity 94.3%; second evaluation sensitivity 90.9%, specificity 96.7%.
links.quote: In the first evaluation, the AI algorithm demonstrated a sensitivity of 84.6% and a specificity of 94.3%.

links.outcome: Repeat local performance evaluation at follow-up after implementation
links.effect: Performance improved from first to second evaluation (sensitivity 84.6% to 90.9%; specificity 94.3% to 96.7%), with fewer unanalyzed scans.
links.quote: By the second evaluation, its performance had improved, achieving a sensitivity of 90.9% and a specificity of 96.7%.

unlisted_practices: Staff acceptance surveys at 3 and 9 months after AI implementation

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic performance and clinical staff acceptance of a commercially available AI tool implemented in a real radiology workflow over time, but does not compare outcomes with and without a specific guardrail or deployment practice.
